name: Fight For Brainrots [UPD]
desc:
Welcome to Fight The Brainrots! ⚔️

⚔️ Roll for weapons and build your loadout!
🏃 Dodge and survive waves of Brainrots!
💀 Rack up kills and claim your enemies!
🏠 Place Brainrots in your base to earn money!

🎰 Spin for rare weapons and upgrade your luck!
🌳 Unlock your Skill Tree and grow stronger!
♾️ Can you reach the ultimate Rebirth...?
